title: Coherent derived reduction, limit adjunction and fiberwise evaluation
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, its valuation ring $R=\mathcal O_E$, a uniformizer $\varpi$, and a scheme $W$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension, def-pc-scheme]. Work on a fixed small skeleton of $W_{\mathrm{proet}}$ [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site, def-weil-size-convention]. Set $B_n=(R/\varpi^n)_W$ for $n\geq1$ and $\widehat R_W=\lim_nB_n$ [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients]. Define $\mathscr S_W$ to be the abelian category of strict sequences of module sheaves $M_n$ over $B_n$, with $B_{n+1}$-linear maps $M_{n+1}\to\operatorname{Res}_{B_{n+1}\to B_n}M_n$, and componentwise module morphisms commuting with these maps; kernels, cokernels and exactness are componentwise [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, def-pc-sheaf-restrict-scalars]. Use ordinary unbounded derived categories [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Write $U_W:D(\mathscr S_W)\to D(\operatorname{Tow}(\operatorname{Mod}(\widehat R_W)))$ for termwise restriction of scalars, and $\mathcal L_W=R\lim\circ U_W$, with the total limit model of [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-strict-tower-homotopy-limit]. A system $N$ is normalized if all its transition-adjoint maps $N_m\otimes^L_{B_m}B_n\to N_n$ are isomorphisms for $m\geq n$ [def-coef-normalized-dvr-tower].

There is a canonical derived adjunction $\mathcal R_W\dashv\mathcal L_W$, where $\mathcal R_W(P)$ is represented by $(Q\otimes_{\widehat R_W}B_n)_n$ and its strict quotient maps for one flat-term K-flat representative $Q\to P$ [def-pc-kflat-complex, def-weil-integral-reduction-tower, lem-pc-kflat-resolution]. Thus $\mathcal R_W$ is a functor on the derived category, not just an assignment to objects. Its unit $u_P:P\to\mathcal L_W\mathcal R_WP$ has composite to level $n$ the actual reduction map $P\to\operatorname{Res}_nP_n$. Its counit $e_N:\mathcal R_W\mathcal L_WN\to N$ evaluates to the scalar-extension adjoint of the total-limit projection; the unit/counit identities hold in the derived system categories.

On normalized systems there is a functorial fiberwise derived internal-Hom system $\mathcal I_W(M,N)\in D(\mathscr S_W)$, contravariant in $M$ and covariant in $N$, whose level $n$ is $R\mathcal Hom_{B_n}(M_n,N_n)$ [def-pur-derived-internal-hom]. Its transitions are the scalar-extension comparisons, using the normalization identifications on both inputs. Use the derived tensor product of module sheaf complexes [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves, def-pc-kflat-complex], with derived scalar extension as in [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings]. The internal-Hom system is equipped with fiberwise tensor-Hom evaluation and transposition maps. These are maps and identities of derived coefficient systems, induced by simultaneous derived tensor-Hom evaluation, rather than arbitrary lifts of evaluated morphisms. The evaluation-defined coefficient comparisons give a natural map
$$\beta_{P,Q}:\mathcal R_W(R\mathcal Hom_{\widehat R_W}(P,Q))\longrightarrow\mathcal I_W(\mathcal R_WP,\mathcal R_WQ)$$
whose level $n$ is the usual evaluation-defined internal-Hom reduction map; it preserves evaluation, transposes and composition as system maps. Here $P,Q$ are arbitrary ambient complexes. A system map is an isomorphism when all its derived evaluations are isomorphisms. Write $\mathcal H_W(M,N)$ for total derived termwise global sections of $U_W\mathcal I_W(M,N)$, as an object of $D(\operatorname{Tow}(\operatorname{Ab}))$; its evaluations are the finite global derived mapping complexes. All constructions and comparisons are natural for morphisms of input derived systems. No reconstruction, invertibility of $u_P$, or invertibility of $\beta_{P,Q}$ for arbitrary inputs is asserted.

Write $R\operatorname{Hom}_{W,B}(P,Q)=R\Gamma(W_{\mathrm{proet}},R\mathcal Hom_B(P,Q))$ for the global derived mapping complex [lem-pur-rhom-global-sections], with the analogous notation at $B_n$. For any $P\in D(\widehat R_W)$ and normalized $N\in D(\mathscr S_W)$ there is a specified natural isomorphism in $D(\operatorname{Ab})$
$$\gamma_{P,N}:R\operatorname{Hom}_{W,\widehat R_W}(P,\mathcal L_WN)\xrightarrow{\sim}R\lim\,\mathcal H_W(\mathcal R_WP,N).$$
It is compatible with the unit and counit of $\mathcal R_W\dashv\mathcal L_W$ and with composition of mapping complexes. If $\pi_n:\mathcal L_WN\to\operatorname{Res}_nN_n$ is the actual total-limit projection and $e_{N,n}:(\mathcal L_WN)_n\to N_n$ its scalar-extension adjoint, then the composite of $\gamma_{P,N}$ with the $n$th mapping-limit projection is the canonical derived scalar-extension adjunction
$$R\operatorname{Hom}_{W,\widehat R_W}(P,\mathcal L_WN)\xrightarrow{(\pi_n)_*}R\operatorname{Hom}_{W,\widehat R_W}(P,\operatorname{Res}_nN_n)\xrightarrow{\sim}R\operatorname{Hom}_{W,B_n}(P_n,N_n)$$
[lem-weil-derived-scalar-extension-restriction-adjunction]. In particular its map on degree-zero Hom sends $h:P\to\mathcal L_WN$ to $e_{N,n}\circ(h\otimes^L_{\widehat R_W}B_n)$. The isomorphism $\gamma$ and these projection identities are specified simultaneously on derived system resolutions and are natural in both inputs. No tensor product of an integral mapping complex with $B_n$ occurs in this assertion.

source.place: Tags 06YS (lemma-K-flat-resolution), 0A95 (lemma-RHom-well-defined), 0941 (lemma-derived-limit-is-ok), together with injectives.tex Tag 079P (theorem-K-injective-embedding-grothendieck). These supply resolution and total-limit models; the simultaneous varying-coefficient realization asserted here is an additional agent-formulated tool, not the statement of any of these tags. The additional enriched reduction/limit adjunction gamma is agent-formulated: it is the coherent comparison for fixed-first-input derived Hom applied to the total limit, followed by extension/restriction adjunction. It asserts neither flatness of the quotient rings nor an arbitrary-input Hom/tensor base-change isomorphism.
